worker.description: RPA Worker: claims jobs from the management portal and runs them on this computer. The first time, paste an invitation from the portal's Devices page; after that it connects on its own.
worker.invite_help: Pair with an invitation (the whole rpa://pair?… line, or the code together with --server), replacing any saved pairing.
worker.server_help: URL of the portal's external port, for example http://192.168.1.10:8081 (when giving only the code).
worker.name_help: Display name; defaults to the computer name.
worker.reset_help: Forget the saved pairing and paste a new invitation.
worker.firefox_help: Also download Firefox (only scenarios that use Firefox need it).
worker.no_testsite_help: Do not start the local test site (http://127.0.0.1:{port}/).
worker.keep_runs_help: Keep the run directories on this computer after uploading them (for troubleshooting).
worker.ask_invite: Paste the invitation from the portal's Devices page (rpa://pair?…), or just the code; press Enter alone to quit:
worker.invite_empty: The invitation is empty: paste the whole invitation line from the Devices page.
worker.invite_format: This is not an invitation: paste the whole rpa://pair?… line from the Devices page, or just the code.
worker.invite_server: The portal's address is not valid: it should look like http://192.168.1.10:8081.
worker.invite_app: The invitation names an unknown app: create a new one on the Devices page.
worker.pair_offline: Cannot reach the portal at {server} ({reason}): check that rpa serve was started there with --worker-port, that its firewall allows incoming connections, and that this computer can reach that address.
worker.paired: Paired as {name} ({device}). Next time it connects on its own.
worker.no_pairing: Not paired yet: open it by double-clicking and paste an invitation, or add --invite on the command line.
worker.ask_firefox: Also download Firefox? Only scenarios that use Firefox need it (y/N):
worker.downloading: Downloading {browser} (first use only; about 150-200 MB to download, about 600 MB unpacked). Please wait…
worker.download_failed: Downloading {browser} failed (exit code {code}). Check that this computer can reach the internet; if your company has an internal mirror, set the PLAYWRIGHT_DOWNLOAD_HOST environment variable and open it again.
worker.testsite_running: Using the test site already running at {url}
worker.testsite_busy: Port {port} is used by another program, so the test site was not started; the example scenarios will fail.
worker.testsite_failed: The test site at {url} could not start: {error}
worker.no_display: This computer has no graphical display; it only claims headless jobs.
worker.started: RPA Worker “{name}” started: portal {server}. Press Ctrl+C or close this window to stop.
worker.stopping: Stopping: the running job is cancelled and its result reported…
worker.event_online: Connected to the portal (device {worker}); waiting for jobs.
worker.event_version: Note: this computer's code version ({mine}) differs from the portal's ({theirs}); updating both to the same version is safer.
worker.event_offline: Cannot reach the portal at {server} ({reason}); retrying automatically.
worker.event_reported: {run} finished: {status}; the result was sent to the portal.
worker.event_abandoned: The portal took {run} back (for example after losing contact); this result is not reported.
worker.event_report_failed: The result could not be sent to the portal: {reason}
worker.pairing_cleared: This pairing no longer works (the device may have been invited again, disabled or deleted on the Devices page). It was removed; paste a new invitation next time you open the app.
worker.press_enter: Press Enter to close this window.
worker.already_running: Another copy of RPA Worker is already using this folder ({home}). Quit it first (tray icon › Quit), then start this one.
worker.darwin.already_running: Another copy of RPA Worker is already using this folder ({home}). Quit it first (menu bar icon › Quit), then start this one.
window.title: RPA Worker
window.subtitle: Takes jobs from the management portal and runs scenarios on this computer.
window.pair_intro: In the management portal, open Production › Devices and choose Add device or Invite again, then paste the invitation below. An invitation works once and expires after 24 hours.
window.server_label: Management portal address (only needed if you paste just the code)
window.firefox_label: Also download Firefox (only needed for Firefox scenarios)
window.download_hint: Only the first time: about 150–200 MB to download, about 600 MB unpacked.
window.storage_file: A file in the data folder (Credential Manager unavailable; see the log)
window.darwin.storage_file: A file in the data folder (Keychain unavailable; see the log)
window.version_mismatch: This computer runs a different program version from the management portal. Updating both to the same version is safer.
window.paused_hint: Paused: no new jobs are taken after the current one finishes. The management portal shows this computer as offline after about a minute.
window.stopping_hint: Stopping: the running job is cancelled and its result reported…
window.recent_empty: No runs since RPA Worker was opened.
window.autostart_label: Start when I sign in to Windows (tray only)
window.darwin.autostart_label: Start when I log in to macOS (menu bar only)
window.autostart_unsupported: Auto-start is only available in the packaged app.
window.mirror_label: Internal mirror for browser downloads (PLAYWRIGHT_DOWNLOAD_HOST; leave empty for the default site)
window.reset_confirm: Pairing again stops taking jobs (a running job is cancelled) and removes this computer's pairing. Continue?
window.quit_confirm: A job is running. Quitting cancels it and reports the result to the management portal. Quit anyway?
window.close_hint: It keeps taking jobs from the notification area. To quit, choose Quit from the tray icon's menu.
window.darwin.close_hint: It keeps taking jobs from the menu bar. To quit, choose Quit from the menu bar icon's menu, or press ⌘Q.
window.pairing_reset: Pairing removed. Paste a new invitation.
window.firefox_next_start: Firefox will be downloaded the next time RPA Worker starts.
window.pair_failed: Pairing failed: the management portal's reply was incomplete ({error}).
window.crashed: RPA Worker stopped: {error}. Details are in the log folder.
window.rejected: The management portal no longer accepts this computer ({message}). It may have been invited again, disabled or deleted on the Devices page. The pairing was removed; paste a new invitation.
window.download_failed: Downloading {browser} failed (exit code {code}). Check that this computer can reach the internet. If your company has an internal mirror, enter it under Settings and choose Retry.
window.webview2_missing: This computer does not have the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, so the status window cannot open. RPA Worker still takes jobs from the notification area. Install it from https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?LinkId=2124703, then reopen RPA Worker.
window.background_help: Start in the notification area (the menu bar on macOS) without opening the window (used by auto-start).
window.no_window_help: Run without a window or tray icon and write messages to the log (for automation and CI).
window.log_help: Log file location (default: logs in the data folder).
window.smoke_help: Open the window and the notification area (menu bar on macOS) icon, check both work, then exit (for CI).
window.report_help: Write the result to a JSON file.
window.reset_busy: The running job has not stopped yet, so the pairing was not removed. Choose Pair again in a moment.
window.keyring_failed: Could not read the token from Windows Credential Manager ({error}). Choose Retry in a moment; if it keeps failing, choose Pair again.
window.darwin.keyring_failed: Could not read the token from the macOS Keychain ({error}). Choose Retry in a moment; if it keeps failing, choose Pair again.
recorder.title: RPA Recorder
recorder.subtitle: Use the management portal through this computer: the browsers for recording, step-by-step debugging and manual login open here.
recorder.description: RPA Recorder: use the management portal through this Mac, with the browsers for recording, step-by-step debugging and manual login opening here. The first time, paste a recorder invitation from the portal's Devices page.
recorder.invite_help: Pair with a recorder invitation (the whole rpa://pair?… line, or the code together with --server), replacing any saved pairing.
recorder.server_help: URL of the portal's external port, for example http://192.168.1.10:8081 (only needed with just the code).
recorder.smoke_help: Open the window, check that the app's page loads through the local gateway, then exit (for CI).
recorder.report_help: Write the result to this JSON file.
recorder.open_help: Open the management portal in the default browser (through the local gateway) once connected.
recorder.url_file_help: Write the address that opens the management portal through the local gateway to this file (readable only by you; valid only until this copy stops, then deleted). For automation.
recorder.no_window_busy: Another RPA Recorder is already using this folder ({home}): quit it first (⌘Q, or put a stop.request file in the folder), then start this one.
recorder.pair_intro: In the portal, open “Production › Devices”, choose “Add device”, set the kind to “RPA Recorder”, and paste the invitation below. An invitation works once and for 24 hours. The portal must open its external port with rpa serve --worker-port.
recorder.server_label: Portal URL (only needed when pasting just the code)
recorder.firefox_label: Also download Firefox (only scenes that use Firefox need it)
recorder.download_hint: Only the first time: about 150–200 MB to download, about 600 MB unpacked.
recorder.storage_file: A file in the folder (the Keychain is unavailable; see the log)
recorder.version_mismatch: This computer's code version differs from the portal's; updating both to the same version is safer.
recorder.no_display: This computer has no graphical display: only headless step-by-step debugging works.
recorder.stopping_hint: Stopping: recordings, debugging and manual logins in progress end…
recorder.active_none: No recording, debugging or manual login in progress.
recorder.active_count: {count} recording, debugging or manual login sessions are running on this computer.
recorder.mirror_label: Internal mirror for browser downloads (PLAYWRIGHT_DOWNLOAD_HOST; leave empty for the default)
recorder.reset_confirm: Pairing again interrupts recordings, debugging and manual logins in progress and removes this computer's pairing. Continue?
recorder.quit_active: {count} recording, debugging or manual login sessions are running on this computer; quitting interrupts them (the portal marks them as ended). Quit anyway?
recorder.paired: Paired as {name} ({device}). It connects directly next time.
recorder.pair_failed: Pairing failed: the portal's reply was incomplete ({error}).
recorder.pairing_reset: Pairing removed: paste a new invitation.
recorder.reset_busy: Work in progress has not stopped yet, so the pairing was kept; choose “Pair again” again shortly.
recorder.firefox_next_start: Firefox is downloaded the next time RPA Recorder opens.
recorder.keyring_failed: The token in the macOS Keychain cannot be read ({error}). Choose “Retry” later; if it keeps failing, choose “Pair again”.
recorder.crashed: RPA Recorder stopped: {error}. Details are in the log folder.
recorder.download_failed: Downloading {browser} failed (exit code {code}). Check that this computer can reach the internet; if your company has an internal mirror, enter it in Settings and choose “Retry”.
recorder.rejected: The portal no longer accepts this computer ({message}). It may have been invited again, disabled or deleted on the Devices page; the pairing was removed, so paste a new invitation.
recorder.event_offline: Cannot reach the portal at {server} ({reason}); retrying automatically.
recorder.offline_body: {server} cannot be reached right now ({reason}). Check that the portal is running and this computer can reach that address, then reload this page.
recorder.notice_unpaired: This RPA Recorder is not paired yet. Use the menu “RPA Recorder › Status and settings” to paste a recorder invitation from the portal's Devices page.
recorder.notice_unauthorized: The portal no longer accepts this recorder's token (it may have been invited again, disabled or deleted on the Devices page). Use the menu “RPA Recorder › Status and settings” to pair again.
recorder.notice_unpaired_no_window: This RPA Recorder is not paired yet: start it again with --invite and a recorder invitation from the portal's Devices page.
recorder.notice_unauthorized_no_window: The portal no longer accepts this recorder's token (it may have been invited again, disabled or deleted on the Devices page): create a new recorder invitation and start it again with --invite.
recorder.already_running: RPA Recorder is already running: bringing its window to the front.
installer.Stopping: Asking RPA Worker to quit: a running job is cancelled and reported to the management portal…
installer.StillRunning: RPA Worker is still running, so setup cannot continue. Choose Quit from the RPA Worker tray icon, then run this again.
installer.WebView2Failed: Microsoft Edge WebView2 was not installed (exit code %1). RPA Worker still takes jobs from the notification area; the status window needs WebView2, which you can install from https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?LinkId=2124703.
installer.RemoveData: Also delete this computer's pairing, settings and logs?%n%nChoose No to keep them, so a reinstall does not need pairing again.
